svg.title: Kirmen Studio - composite filament winding CAM and 3D simulation
svg.desc: A Type-IV pressure vessel rotating between headstock and tailstock chucks while a 4-axis carriage moves along its rail, pivoting the payout eye at each dome turnaround and laying a helical carbon-fiber band onto the surface.
